blocks.text: What a Mod changes, and when to use each one.
A Mod changes what a warship fires. Research it once, then pick it when a Shipyard builds a warship.
Nothing is fitted after a ship is built, and Starbases, Outposts and Defense Batteries take no Mods.
A Shipyard builds a hull with the variant and Mod you pick.
Corvettes have one nose gun; a turret-type Mod gives them one hidden nose turret.
What each Mod costs and does, in numbers: see Research > Mods.
Each blast hits every enemy inside it for full damage: spread out against them. Drawn to scale.
Seeker Drones orbit until an enemy is near, then pierce through enemy after enemy.
Hit damage scales with Mark and Munitions.
Tractors burn harder up close and pull targets in; an Ion Lance ramps up on one target.
Proton Torpedoes are built to hunt big hulls.
They do not steer: each flies straight at laser speed, so a ship that moves sideways can slip one.
